description: Use when the user asks how fast an AI company grew or for its revenue over time. Returns one business's dated revenue series, oldest first (as_of, annualized_usd, label, value_usd, source_url; MRR x12). Example: {"slug":"lovable"} -> Lovable's dated ARR points with sources. Unknown slug -> isError. Cost: free (100 calls/day without a key).
name: get_growth
title: Revenue over time (one business)
